subject: EOQ OKR Scores, Root-Cause Narratives & Playbook for QBR
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Joshi <samir.j@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ OKR Scores, Root-Cause Narratives & Playbook for QBR

Team —

Attaching the working EOQ scores workbook (EOQ_scores_draft.xlsx). Goal is to have a clean set of scores + one-paragraph root-cause narratives for any objective scored below 7 so the leadership narrative is honest about tradeoffs and remediation. High-level ask: please do line-level edits in the workbook and drop short narrative files where noted.

Quick timeline:
- Please update scores + add narratives by EOD Thu 3/3 PST.
- I’ll compile final pack and circulate on 3/5 for review.
- QBR dry-run is scheduled 3/8.

Items I specifically want input on:
1) O2 (Serving runtime throughput) — current draft score 6. If we upgrade to the 2.1 kernel set, how should we reflect that progress?
2) O4 (Platform adoption) — numbers look close but variance on paid conversion needs a one-line explanation.

Attachment: EOQ_scores_draft.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — please keep this thread for edits so I can track changes.

—
Dylan Brooks
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ OKR Scores, Root-Cause Narratives & Playbook for QBR

On Mon, Mar 1, 2027 at 9:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Attaching the working EOQ scores workbook (EOQ_scores_draft.xlsx). Goal is to have a clean set of scores + one-paragraph root-cause narratives for any objective scored below 7 so the leadership narrative is honest about tradeoffs and remediation. High-level ask: please do line-level edits in the workbook and drop short narrative files where noted.

Thanks for pulling this together, Dylan — quick notes from my side: 
- O2: I support moving to 7 if we clearly call out the mitigation timeline. The throughput lift is real but not fully rolled to production for large-context customers.
- Suggest a concise root-cause for the delay: "Interim kernel incompatibilities + delayed infra capacity (reserved GPU pools) pushed back rollout by 3 weeks." That covers both engineering and infra constraints.
- For O4 conversion variance: add one line tying it to promo timing and a recent change in free-tier token limits.

I’ve drafted a short file for O2 and dropped it in the shared folder: O2_narrative.docx (see attachments).

—
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ OKR Scores, Root-Cause Narratives & Playbook for QBR

Thanks — couple of priorities from leadership perspective: 

1) Root-cause depth: For any objective <7 we need a brief RCA paragraph that includes (a) the proximate cause, (b) customer impact (if any), and (c) the short mitigation plan + owner. This helps the board/QBR narrative and keeps ask concrete.

2) O2 / large customers: Laura’s phrasing is good. Add a line about expected rollback risk if the kernel rollout hits quantization edge cases; call out top impacted accounts (e.g., Acme Corp) so CS can message them proactively.

3) Cost signal: include token-cost variance for O4 in the appendix — we should show delta vs. prior quarter.

I’m copying Monica to have the QBR playbook template filled with the items above. Monica — can you slot a 30-minute dry-run on Thu 3/4 10:00–10:30 PT?

Attachment: QBR_playbook_template.md

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Joshi <samir.j@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: EOQ OKR Scores, Root-Cause Narratives & Playbook for QBR — consolidated pack

Folks — thanks for the quick turn. I consolidated edits and produced a v3 of the scores workbook and a compiled narrative PDF. Links/attachments below. Key decisions included:

- O2 moved to 7 (language added about kernel compatibility and a two-week mitigation window; owner: @PlatformEng).
- O4 appendix now contains token-cost delta and a one-line conversion-note tied to promo timing.
- For any objective <7 we now have a 3-part RCA (cause, impact, mitigation + owner) as Vivek requested.

Attachments: EOQ_scores_v3.xlsx (xlsx), compiled_narratives.pdf (pdf)
Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/EOQ-QBR-2027

Next steps:
- Monica to lead the 30-min dry-run 3/4 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
- I will circulate final slide pack on 3/7 for 48-hour review.

Samir — I left a short note in the appendix about Acme-specific impact and the outreach plan your team can expect. Happy to sync offline if useful.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
